guidance.claim: Expect a volume growth of 8% to 9% going forward.
guidance.quote: we feel that it would be reasonable to expect to see a volume growth of about 8% to 9% going forward.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

guidance.claim: Gross margin band should be 41% to 43% going forward.
guidance.quote: This band of about 41% to 43% would really be the band we should be looking forward to.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

guidance.claim: Maintain the EBITDA margin band of 18% to 20% for the year.
guidance.quote: We believe as we go forward, for the year we should be able to maintain the band of what we have spoken of 18% to 20%.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

guidance.claim: Utilize full capacity of phase one of VAE plant next year.
guidance.quote: As we go , we will be looking at a part of the overall capacity of what we will utilize till March and what we plan is that next year we will be 32 | able to utilize the full capacity of this phase one of going forward .
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

guidance.claim: VAE plant to give 300 bps to 500 bps advantage on relevant products.
guidance.quote: It should really give us some advantage of 300 bps to 500 bps on relevant products.
guidance.speaker: Amit Syngle

reported.claim: Q2 volume growth was 6.4% on a high base.
reported.quote: we have been able to grow at a good volume of about 6.4% at the base of the last year, which was almost about an 11% growth in terms of a like-to-like quarter.
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle

reported.claim: Q2 value growth was 14.5% for decorative business.
reported.quote: When we look at the whole area of value of the decorative business, so I spoke of a 6.4% volume growth, the value growth has also been very strong at 14.5%.
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle

reported.claim: Kitchen and Bath business growth was astronomical at almost 34%.
reported.quote: Here, the growth has been astronomical, almost 34% of the growth we have garnered here.
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle

reported.claim: Standalone PBDIT margin was 17.1% in Q2.
reported.quote: If you see from a like-to-like quarter perspective, PBDIT margin is about 17.1% compared to the last year, same quarter which was about 18.5%.
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle

reported.claim: H1 PBDIT margin was in the higher range at 19.6%.
reported.quote: The great thing to look at is that the PBDIT margin growth at a half-year level is very good and the PBDIT margin is in the higher range of the overall band of what we have been speaking at 19.6%.
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle
